ledger: Leftmost block, front: 00:00.000 reads 2; after handling, 00:00.750–00:09.750 reads 2. Early motion-blurred views excluded.
Second block from left, blue front: 00:01.250–00:09.750 reads 3, including after the final hand contact.

Initially right-hand green block, later third from left: 00:00.000–00:02.400 reads 2; 00:02.450–00:02.950 reads 3 on the same forward-facing surface. By 00:03.250, a 2 occupies the third position and a separate handheld 3 is immediately to its right; the third-position 2 remains through 00:09.750.
Fourth-position handheld block: 00:03.250–00:03.600 reads 3; following visible turning, 00:03.750–00:09.750 reads 2 on its yellow front. The turn prevents a confident same-face violation.
Fifth block, pale blue front: 00:04.250–00:09.750 reads 3; sharp settled readings at 00:04.750 and 00:05.000.
Sixth block, handheld blue-to-green front: 00:05.250–00:05.900 reads 3; 00:05.950–00:09.750 reads 5. Another 3-bearing block becomes visible to its right during placement.
Seventh block, handheld green front: 00:06.250–00:06.650 reads 3; 00:06.700–00:09.750 reads 2. A separate blue 3-bearing block becomes visible to its right.
Eighth/rightmost blue block, front: 00:06.750–00:07.650 reads 3; 00:07.750–00:09.750 reads 6, sharply legible once placed.

Exposed narrow side faces: recognizable 6 numerals on the first two blue blocks around 00:01.500–00:02.500; remaining angled, occluded, or blurred side markings are insufficient for reliable character comparisons.
Final front-face sequence at 00:08.000–00:09.750: 2 3 2 2 3 5 2 6. All settled numerals are coherent; no independently supported garbled-text defect.

findings.entity: Front numeral of the initially right-hand green block, third from left
findings.description: The clearly readable 2 at 00:02.400 becomes a clearly readable 3 by 00:02.450–00:02.500. The hand lifts and slightly tilts the block, but its broad front and narrow right side remain in view; no face exchange, rewriting, or label replacement explains the changed numeral.

findings.entity: Front numeral of the sixth block from left
findings.description: The green front reads 3 at 00:05.850–00:05.900 and 5 at 00:05.950–00:06.000. Its forward-facing surface changes during placement without a turn exposing another face or any visible editing of the numeral. A separate 3-bearing block appears to its right, but that does not explain the original front changing to 5.

findings.entity: Front numeral of the seventh block from left
findings.description: The handheld green front clearly reads 3 at 00:06.500–00:06.600, then reads 2 by 00:06.700–00:06.750 as it is lowered. The broad front remains directed toward the camera, with no face-changing rotation or text replacement. A blue block bearing 3 emerges beside it during the unexplained change.

findings.entity: Front numeral of the eighth, rightmost blue block
findings.description: The blue block reads 3 while held at 00:07.500–00:07.650, then reads 6 at 00:07.750 and remains 6 through the end. The same broad front stays visible while the hand lowers the block; a slight tilt does not expose a different numbered face, and no writing or replacement occurs.
